title: AI questions from the owner and staff cost the gym nothing and have no total limit per gym
what: AI questions asked by the gym owner or any staff person take no credit and are paid by MettleUp. The only limit is 60 a day for each person. There is no total for the whole gym, and no check that the gym is paying: a trial gym or a free demo gym gets the same. A gym with many staff logins, or many demo gyms, can run up MettleUp's AI bill or use up the shared daily ceiling for everyone, and nothing warns MettleUp as this spend grows.
expected: A daily total of free owner and staff questions for each gym (lower for trial and demo gyms), and a warning to MettleUp when free AI spend passes a set amount in a day or a month.
how_often: every day, growing with staff and gyms
fix_line: Add a whole-gym daily total for free owner and staff AI questions and warn MettleUp past a set spend

title: Gym web page photos have a daily upload limit but no total per gym, and removed photos are never deleted
what: An owner may upload up to 60 web page photos of up to 1 MB each every day. There is no limit on how many a gym keeps in total, and files of photos taken off the page stay in storage for ever because the clean-up job was left for later. A single gym, or a stream of free demo gyms, can add about 60 MB a day each to the 1 GB of free picture storage that all gyms share. When that store is full, every gym's photo uploads stop, and nothing warns MettleUp first.
expected: A total number of page photos per gym, a job that deletes files no page uses, and a storage-size warning to MettleUp well before the free limit.
how_often: once the web page part is turned on
fix_line: Cap page photos per gym, delete unused photo files, and warn on storage size
